name: Hard-Wired Sprite (Champion)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Technomancy* sphere, Tinker UEn sphere (at least one (gizmo) talent).

Benefit(s): One gizmo that you create (excluding permanent gizmos) contains a sprite with a permanent duration that cannot be transferred. This sprite replenishes itself after 1 minute if it is dispelled or destroyed. You may change which gizmo is affected by this feat in a process that takes 1 hour.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you may select a different gizmo to gain a sprite.
